note: Snapshot from main (04ba0454) before LM-405. The non-TIPS PROFIT_LOSS and PROFIT_LOSS_PERCENT wording, meaning and rounding stay: every proto comment line stays, in order, above the TIPS paragraph; each catalog formula is a prefix of the new one; every model assumption stays.

PROFIT_LOSS: // The profit or loss on a position relative to its cost basis.
//   Where d = 100 for par-quoted securities (bonds, TIPS, FRNs) and
// Example (bond): MV=19,000, UCB=90 (% of par), qty=20000 face →
// Example (equity): MV=5,500, UCB=50 (dollars per share), qty=100 →
// The measure is absent, never 0, when MarketValue, UnadjustedCostBasis
PROFIT_LOSS_PERCENT: // The profit or loss as a percentage of the original cost basis.
//   Where d = 100 for par-quoted securities (bonds, TIPS, FRNs) and
// The measure is absent, never 0, when MarketValue, UnadjustedCostBasis

PROFIT_LOSS.name: PROFIT_LOSS
PROFIT_LOSS.description: The profit or loss on a position relative to its cost basis.
PROFIT_LOSS.formula: ProfitLoss = MarketValue - (UnadjustedCostBasis / d * DirectedQuantity), where d = 100 for par-quoted securities (bonds, TIPS, FRNs) and d = 1 for dollar-quoted securities (equities, cash)
model_assumptions: The measure is absent, never 0, when MarketValue, UnadjustedCostBasis or DirectedQuantity is unavailable

PROFIT_LOSS_PERCENT.name: PROFIT_LOSS_PERCENT
PROFIT_LOSS_PERCENT.description: The profit or loss as a percentage of the original cost basis.
PROFIT_LOSS_PERCENT.formula: ProfitLossPercent = ProfitLoss / (UnadjustedCostBasis / d * DirectedQuantity), where d = 100 for par-quoted securities (bonds, TIPS, FRNs) and d = 1 for dollar-quoted securities (equities, cash)
model_assumptions: The measure is absent, never 0, when MarketValue, UnadjustedCostBasis or DirectedQuantity is unavailable
